title: Warrior's Weapons Unleashed
description: A name-based weapon resource pack that is the sequel to my previous weapon pack "Warrior's Weapons".
body:
Warrior's Weapons Unleashed is the sequel to my previous name-based Resource Pack called "Warrior's Weapons". This pack **requires Optifine or CIT Resewn** to work. This pack is still in development so expect updates _(hopefully)_ every month.

The current weapons and their names are:
- Diamond/Netherite Sword - Exitium
- Mace - Flagellum
